subject.title: Runtime Self Context: give agents runtime, scale, offload, and cost awareness

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core runtimeContext config plus model-facing runtime tool as the v1 contract for runtime/offload/cost awareness, or should the work be narrowed or redirected to plugin/API design first?
rationale: The requested surface changes core config, prompt exposure, model-facing tools, session context, and future provider/plugin responsibilities, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Review PR 90101 as the v1 core contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR to decide whether the proposed config-backed runtimeContext and runtime tool are the right lean first slice.

options.title: Narrow to extension seams first
options.body: Ask the contributor to reduce the core work to missing plugin/provider hooks and defer model-facing config/tool exposure until those seams are settled.

options.title: Pause broader runtime/offload design
options.body: Hold this issue and the linked PR until execution placement, runtime self-context, offload actions, and cost estimation are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Review PR 90101 as the v1 core contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR to decide whether the proposed config-backed runtimeContext and runtime tool are the right lean first slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merger on central agent/runtime files and a plausible maintainer routing point for the core contract decision.
